summary: San Bernardino NF summit above Banning, CA. Lookout moved from Black Mountain to Barton Peak in 1935, removed by 1970; cab foundation photographed in 2013. FFLA lists it gone.

facts.status_note: Peakbagging says the lookout was removed by 1970; a 2013 photo shows the cab foundation; the FFLA list marks it Gone

events.note: March 1934 plans: Black Mountain's fourth station to be transferred to Barton peak above Banning; a tower to be built there by men from the Vista Grande camp
Original Black Mountain lookout disassembled and rebuilt on Barton Peak (Forest Service); Peakbagging says it was dismantled from Black Mountain and set up by the CCC
Lookout Ronald Swart on watch; lightning hit the Barton peak station in September 1939 and stopped his watch
Peakbagging: by 1970 the lookout had been removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts uses Barton Peak; the FFLA list uses Barker Peak (Barton); Peakbagging says the peak was originally known as Barton Peak. The record keeps the FFLA name with Barton Peak as an other name.
March 1934 newspaper items describe a planned tower; the Forest Service and Peakbagging date the rebuilt lookout to 1935.

notes_for_editor: Built, staffing and removal are each sourced by at least one dated item. The CCC attribution comes only from Peakbagging; Forest Lookouts says men from the Vista Grande camp. Peakbagging's Barker Peak page says the cab stood from 1935 to the late 1960s, while the same page says the lookout was removed by 1970. Elevation 4360 ft (about 1329 m) appears on the Peakbagging Barker Peak page, not in the facts schema. No source describes trail access or current condition beyond the 2013 foundation photo, so access is left out of facts. The Forest Service Black Mountain page covers the Black Mountain lookout only as a 1926 build and a 1935 move.
